priorityList: Keep Shield Block active at all times, refreshing when it has 10 or fewer seconds remaining.
Use Ignore Pain to prevent capping Rage, especially when Shield Slam or Demoralizing Shout are coming off cooldown.
Cast Demolish once you have accumulated 3 or more stacks of Colossal Might.
Cast Avatar if the Thunder Blast buff is missing or has 2 or fewer stacks remaining.
Use Ravager, Champion's Spear, and Shield Charge on cooldown for AoE damage and Rage generation.
Cast Demoralizing Shout on cooldown to benefit from the Booming Voice damage and Rage buff.
Use Thunder Blast or Thunder Clap to apply and maintain the Rend bleed on all targets.
Prioritize Thunder Blast as your primary rotational ability in AoE encounters.
Cast Execute on targets in AoE if you have a Sudden Death proc or high Rage while Heavy Handed is talented.
Use Shield Slam as your priority generator if Rage is below 60 or if Violent Outburst is active.
Use Thunder Clap as your main filler ability when Thunder Blast is not available.
Spend excess Rage on Revenge if you are above 70 Rage to avoid capping resources.
